name: Category Five
author: drewchristopher
description:
It's pouring rain as a Category Five Hurricane is about to touch ground. As you and your friend try to make your way home, you must survive by jumping over the sliding cars in your path. Created from Unity's Jump Force Project, I've added MODs by adding an additional player, changed out the obstacle for a car, created/edited the city background in illustrator and created rain using these easy resources: (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VN6RzRQ-SWU
